models.label: Self-healing circuit (random wiring)
models.description: The headline model. Random wiring trained with bursty 'solar-event' gate damage. Settles to the target, recovers when rewired (Shuffle), and re-grows function around permanently destroyed gates (Shotgun) — repeatedly back to ~100%. Deep-probed settled 0.93 / shuffle-carry 0.92; actively heals ~64% of shotgun knockout damage. Curated all-rounder pool (boot + shuffle + shotgun-recovery, robust-averaged).
